confirmed_blockers: The attempt-18 adapter immediately drops its Box instead of retaining ownership in real deferred or quarantine vectors.
The attempt-18 runner names the required method chain only in strings and invokes none of the real methods.
Its adapter.diff, inverse records and manifest contain assertions rather than genuine diffs and file bindings.

released_design.host_driver: Use each runner.rs as a standalone std host-test crate loading the exact application_rpc, application_syscall, smp_application_syscall, stability_observer and stability_phase modules, plus only the minimal runner-local fallible Vec/log/clock compatibility surface.
released_design.ownership: Ledger owns Mutex<State>; State owns actual Vec<Box<AlignedBacking>> deferred and quarantine queues. Transfer the sole Box into the appropriate queue, drop outside the lock only during explicit drain, and record deallocation after that drop.
released_design.real_method_chain: A cfg(test) child of smp_application_syscall constructs and decodes the exact read request, then invokes real new, open_worker, admit, reserve, copied, verification_read16, observer selection, phase arm and return_value operations.
released_design.status_hook: Add only a cfg(test) metadata hook immediately after the real response-status store and before release; do not fabricate Status from release.
released_design.row03: After an accepted stage-2 baseline, publish Err(-11); publication deltas remain zero, mailbox destruction records unfinished/quarantine/live, and explicit drain records one deallocation.
released_design.row12: After an accepted stage-2 baseline, publish Ok(true) at stage 3/commit 1; address, status, release, deferred and finished each advance once, send remains zero, and explicit drain records one deallocation.
released_design.isolation: Use a fresh process for every row and mode when a separately authorized execution packet exists, because observer and token state are one-shot.

bounded_future_scope: One fresh packet-11-shaped remediation root; candidate edits only in the three named production source files plus adapters, runners, parser and enumerated evidence files. Both failed roots remain immutable.
acceptance_requirements: A future packet must prove actual method calls and signatures, unique backing ownership, exact event ordering, metadata-only post-store hooks, complete cfg erasure, genuine adapter-to-staged-to-original byte restoration, exhaustive hashes and strict result parsing. It may not claim observations before execution.
